newsitem.title: USA: Compaq says makes $300 mln tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Compaq says makes $300 mln tender offer.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said on Monday that it had launched a $300 million tender offer in outstanding senior notes to reduce the company's long-term debt and interest expense.
The offer is for the company's 6 1/2 percent senior notes due March 15, 1999, and for its 7 1/4 percent senior notes due March 15, 2004, Compaq said in a statement.
The offer began Monday and expires at 5:00 p.m. EDT on May 22, the company said. The company will purchase the securities with cash from operations.
Goldman, Sachs and Co and Merrill Lynch and Co are acting as dealer managers for the tender offer, Compaq said.
Compaq Computer Corp is a global supplier of personal computers.
